rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Steve Hofmeyr
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, before 2009).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2009 as 'Steve Hofmeyr'.
rows.Bloom: Lavender and purple. Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered, urn-shaped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
